$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency audit (docs/security/vulnerability-management.md). Each entry needs advisory (GHSA id), package, reason, owner, added (YYYY-MM-DD) and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days after added). The CI job fails when an entry has expired. Prefer upgrading the dependency over adding an entry.

entries.reason: braces 3.0.3 comes in through micromatch inside Expo's CLI and Metro bundler (apps/mobile build tooling, run on a developer or CI machine, never in the shipped app or the server) and no fixed 3.x release exists yet. Re-check each week; upgrade Expo when a fix lands.

node-forge 1.4.0 comes in through @expo/code-signing-certificates inside the Expo CLI (mobile build tooling only, signs nothing for customers' data) and no fixed release exists yet. Upgrade when one is published.

image-size 1.2.1 comes in through the Metro bundler (mobile build tooling). The fix is in 2.x, a major upgrade Metro has to make itself; it reads local project images only. Upgrade Expo/Metro when it moves to image-size 2.
Same dependency and reason as GHSA-5P2G-FCMC-QVQQ above (Metro bundler, mobile build tooling, fix needs image-size 2.x).
